attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Ninefingers Gang has been quiet since a failed raid on Gladwater.","severity":"major","reason":"repeats old news from the latest bulletin as if new, and the failed raid is not in this briefing"},{"span":"They have three settlements scattered around.","severity":"minor","reason":"'scattered around' adds a detail about their spread that the briefing does not give"},{"span":"The Lantern Accord hosts a trade fair at Lantern Hill.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as an ongoing event; the briefing only says it is being hosted, and this is the lead-in to a rehash"},{"span":"The Reedmother's Children report the river is full and the fish are foolish.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the previous bulletin as if new, with no marker that it is old"},{"span":"One assumes they mean they have plenty of things to complain about.","severity":"minor","reason":"framed as a guess, so not a fact; the 'good combination' attribution is a rehash of old news"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The only new item is a single bare sentence with no dry remark, and the rest rehashes old bulletins as if fresh, ignoring the rule against repeating old news. It runs too long for a quiet week and leans on the stale material instead of a short bulletin."}
